title: Held-out: physical therapy clinic tracking referral sources

answers.q3_details: Practice name, doctor name, contact email, referral date, referral type (new patient, follow-up, discharge), specialty, next check-in date, notes
answers.q5_multi_area_copy: Yes, put each referral in the log for its specialty too.
answers.q7_contributor_alert: Yes, email me when either of them adds a referral.
answers.q8_follow_up: Yes, remind me 3 days before the next check-in date.

expected.notes: Held-out. One main log plus one per specialty. The reminder must anchor on the next check-in date field. Digest send_hour 9. The specialty field is what routing keys on.
